overview_description.description: Chum is a UAE-based digital platform focused on price comparison and online shopping deals. It allows users to compare prices across different retailers and service providers. The platform also features cashback offers, discounts, and promotional listings in categories such as shopping and travel. It operates as an online consumer savings and discovery service.
